Apple.label: Apple
Apple.description: An apple a day keeps the zombie doctor away...

Banana.label: Banana
Banana.description: Make sure it's your banana, and not some monkey's.

Orange.label: Orange
Orange.description: Life gave me oranges instead of lemons.

soda lemon.label: Soda (Lemon)
soda lemon.description: Refreshing stale soda. Nothing like it.

water bottle.label: Water Bottle
water bottle.description: Fresh water bottled water. Who would have thought this would be so valuable one day?

can of beans.label: Can of Beans
can of beans.description: Just like Mom used to make.

can of sardines.label: Can of Sardines
can of sardines.description: Canned fish is a weird concept

mac n cheese box.label: Mac 'n' Cheese Box
mac n cheese box.description: It's an all time favorite for a reason, right?

first aid kit.label: First Aid Kit
first aid kit.description: Contains everything one needs in the case of an emergency. [Fully heals][removes bleeding][Cures wounds][Cures injuries]

first aid spray.label: First Aid Spray
first aid spray.description: A pressurized medical spray for treating damage quickly. [Heals 25 HP]

medical herbs.label: Medical Herbs
medical herbs.description: A bundle of medicinal herbs prepared for treating minor injuries. [Heals 20 HP]

vitalis.label: Vitalis
vitalis.description: A mysterious single-dose injector that restores the body completely. [Fully heals] [Stops bleeding]

trauma bag.label: Trauma Bag
trauma bag.description: A stocked trauma bag with enough supplies for repeated treatment. [Heals 15 HP] [Stops bleeding] [Cures wounds]

painkillers.label: Painkillers
painkillers.description: These can get rid of a bad headache.

antibiotics.label: Antibiotics
antibiotics.description: These are really hard to find.

herbal poultice.label: Herbal Poultice
herbal poultice.description: A bundle of crushed medicinal plants wrapped for direct treatment. Smells healthier than it looks.

tourniquet.label: Tourniquet
tourniquet.description: A sturdy compression strap for emergencies. Tighten first, complain later.

surgical treatment kit.label: Surgical Treatment Kit
surgical treatment kit.description: A compact surgical kit for wounds that refuse to stay simple. [Heals 25 HP] [Stops bleeding] [Treats one wound or injury]

Gears.label: Gears
Gears.description: Metal gears that seem usefull for something.

nails.label: Nails
nails.description: Regular old nails. If only I had a hammer...

bolts.label: Bolts
bolts.description: Too bad it's not thunder bolts.

wooden stick.label: Wooden Stick
wooden stick.description: A wooden shaft. Could have many uses

metal bar.label: Metal Bar
metal bar.description: A Metal shaft. Nothing out of the ordinary

metal sheet.label: Metal Sheet
metal sheet.description: Sheet of metal, usefull for barricades.

screwdriver.label: Screwdriver
screwdriver.description: No one can live without one of these.

Nail gun.label: Nail Gun
Nail gun.description: I bet this could do some damage

electrical drill.label: Electrical Drill
electrical drill.description: A standard electric drill used for construction and repairs.

hand drill.label: Hand Drill
hand drill.description: a manually operated drill. Quiet and reliable.

tape measure.label: Tape Measure
tape measure.description: A retractable tape measure used for precise measurements

level.label: Level
level.description: A level used to ensre surfaces are perfectly horizontal or vertical.

pipe wrench.label: Pipe Wrench
pipe wrench.description: A rugge pipe wrench. Built for plumbing but heavy enough to bash some skulls

safety goggles.label: Safety Goggles
safety goggles.description: plastic goggles necessary to not loose an eye or two.

corrugated hose.label: Corrugated Hose
corrugated hose.description: usefull in more ways then one

insulating tape.label: Insulating Tape
insulating tape.description: Simple insulating tape for electrical repairs.

plexiglass.label: Plexiglass
plexiglass.description: A transparent thermoplastic acrylic known for its high clarity, low weight, and superior impact resistance compared to traditional glass.

screw nuts.label: Screw Nuts
screw nuts.description: A handful of durable metal nuts used to fasten mechanical parts together. Essential for repairing equipment and crafting sturdy structures.

sealing foam.label: Sealing Foam
sealing foam.description: Expanding foam used to seal gaps, cracks, and leaks.

silicone tube.label: Silicone Tube
silicone tube.description: A cartridge of flexible silicone sealant used to waterproof joints, seal gaps, and bond a variety of materials.

superglue.label: Superglue
superglue.description: This has fixed many sandals in my day...

wood glue.label: Wood Glue
wood glue.description: industrial glue made for keeping wood pieces in place.

spark plug.label: Spark Plug
spark plug.description: A small engine component that generates the electrical spark needed to ignite the air-fuel mixture in gasoline engines.

usb adapter.label: USB Adapter
usb adapter.description: A small adapter used to connect incompatible USB devices.

aa battery.label: AA Battery
aa battery.description: everyday AA batteries from the era of handheld videogames.

wd 40.label: WD-40
wd 40.description: A can of versatile penetrating lubricant. Perfect for freeing seized mechanisms, silencing squeaky hinges, and maintaining worn equipment.

awl.label: Awl
awl.description: A pointed tool used to pierce holes in various materials.

multitool.label: Multitool
multitool.description: A compact tool with multiple built-in functions for repairs and crafting.

wi fi camera.label: Wi-Fi Camera
wi fi camera.description: A wireless camera used for remote surveillance and monitoring.

RAM.label: RAM
RAM.description: A salvaged stick of computer memory. While useless on its own, it's a key component for repairing computers and assembling advanced electronic equipment.

graphics card.label: Graphics Card
graphics card.description: A dedicated GPU used to process graphics and computational workloads.

processor.label: Processor
processor.description: A computer processor used to execute instructions and manage system operations.

motherboard.label: Motherboard
motherboard.description: The backbone of every computer. Scarred by dust and time, it still has the potential to bring dormant machines back to life—provided you can find the missing parts.

power supply unit.label: Power Supply Unit
power supply unit.description: A device that supplies regulated power to computer components.

light bulb.label: Light Bulb
light bulb.description: A standard electric light bulb used to provide illumination in homes, buildings, and portable fixtures.

magnet.label: Magnet
magnet.description: A durable permanent magnet used in electronic devices, machinery, and advanced crafting.

hard drive.label: Hard Drive
hard drive.description: A storage device used to permanently store digital data.

ssd drive.label: SSD Drive
ssd drive.description: A high-speed flash storage device used in modern computers.

mouse.label: Mouse
mouse.description: A functional computer mouse salvaged from an abandoned workstation.

keyboard.label: Keyboard
keyboard.description: Simple office keyboard for office work by office employee

t shaped plug.label: T-Shaped Plug
t shaped plug.description: usefull for pluging in various things into a single socket. Cause of many fires too

power bar.label: Power Bar
power bar.description: A row of outlets for when one socket just isn't enough. Probably safer than the T-shaped plug.

extension cord.label: Extension Cord
extension cord.description: A long electrical cord for bringing power where the wall socket couldn't be bothered to reach.

usb c cable.label: USB-C Cable
usb c cable.description: A reversible cable for charging and data. Somehow still never the one you need.

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.description: A salvaged microphone for capturing voices. In a quiet world, someone may still need to be heard.

headphones.label: Headphones
headphones.description: A pair of headphones for private listening. Useful when you don't want every zombie nearby hearing it too.

calculator.label: Calculator
calculator.description: A pocket calculator for quick figures. Long division didn't get any easier after the apocalypse.

walkie talkie.label: Walkie-Talkie
walkie talkie.description: A handheld radio for short-range communication. Better than shouting and attracting everything nearby.

smartphone.label: Smartphone
smartphone.description: A modern smartphone with no signal and a dying battery. The parts are still worth salvaging.

lcd screen.label: LCD Screen
lcd screen.description: A flat LCD panel salvaged from an old device. Fragile, useful, and somehow not cracked yet.

bundle of wires.label: Bundle of Wires
bundle of wires.description: A tangled bundle of insulated wires. Every useful cable seems to begin as a knot.

capacitors.label: Capacitors
capacitors.description: Small electronic components that store electrical charge. Tiny cans of lightning, if treated with respect.

cpu fan.label: CPU Fan
cpu fan.description: A small cooling fan that keeps processors from cooking themselves. Dust included.

power cord.label: Power Cord
power cord.description: A standard power cord—the essential connection between a useful machine and a dead wall socket.

printed circuit board.label: Printed Circuit Board
printed circuit board.description: A densely traced board covered in tiny components. The green maze that makes electronics think.

flash drive.label: Flash Drive
flash drive.description: A pocket-sized storage drive. It could contain instructions, secrets, or someone's vacation photos.

floppy disk.label: Floppy Disk
floppy disk.description: An obsolete square of magnetic storage. It holds less than a photo, yet collectors treat it like treasure.

game cd.label: Game CD
game cd.description: A scratched game disc from simpler times. No internet required—just power, a working machine, and luck.

wi fi router.label: Wi-Fi Router
wi fi router.description: A wireless router built to connect a household. It now broadcasts to a world with nobody left online.

webcam.label: Webcam
webcam.description: A small camera once used for meetings and awkward family calls. Its lens can still watch whatever you point it at.

Syringe.label: Syringe
Syringe.description: A sterile syringe for drawing or delivering medicine. The needle is the least worrying part.

blood kit.label: Blood Test Kit
blood kit.description: A compact kit for checking blood samples. Bad news fits in a very small box.

suture needles.label: Suture Needles
suture needles.description: Curved needles meant for closing wounds. Thread not included; courage sold separately.

Cotton balls.label: Cotton Balls
Cotton balls.description: Soft cotton balls for cleaning wounds and applying medicine. Somehow they still escape every opened bag.

empty iv bag.label: Empty IV Bag
empty iv bag.description: An empty sterile IV bag waiting to be filled. Not useful alone, but neither is a vein.

tweezers.label: Tweezers
tweezers.description: Fine metal tweezers for removing splinters, glass, and other things that shouldn't be inside you.

surgical gloves.label: Surgical Gloves
surgical gloves.description: A sealed pair of surgical gloves. Clean hands are a luxury; sterile ones are a miracle.

surgical tubes.label: Surgical Tubes
surgical tubes.description: Flexible medical tubing for moving fluids where they need to go. Best not to think too hard about which fluids.

scalpel.label: Scalpel
scalpel.description: A surgical blade made for precise cuts. Sharp enough to make mistakes permanent.

bottle of multivitamins.label: Bottle of Multivitamins
bottle of multivitamins.description: A bottle of once-daily vitamins. Months of nutrition condensed into pills nobody enjoyed taking.

bottle of saline solution.label: Bottle of Saline Solution
bottle of saline solution.description: A sterile bottle of saltwater for cleaning wounds and replacing fluids. Simple, boring, lifesaving.

ophthalmoscope.label: Ophthalmoscope
ophthalmoscope.description: A handheld instrument for inspecting eyes. If someone asks you to follow the light, hope they know what they're doing.

empty first aid spray.label: Empty First-Aid Spray
empty first aid spray.description: An empty First Aid Spray canister. The medicine is gone, but the container still has another life in it.

goldenrod flowers.label: Goldenrod Flowers
goldenrod flowers.description: Bright yellow medicinal flowers. Pretty enough to pick, useful enough to keep.

broadleaf plantain leaves.label: Broadleaf Plantain Leaves
broadleaf plantain leaves.description: Broad medicinal leaves. Civilization fell, but field remedies kept growing.

empty auto injector.label: Empty Auto-Injector
empty auto injector.description: An empty automatic injector. The clever part still works; now it only needs something worth injecting.

compass.label: Compass
compass.description: A pocket compass that always points north. Whether north is where you should go is another matter.

clipboard.label: Clipboard
clipboard.description: A rigid board for keeping papers in order. Bureaucracy survived longer than most people.

pen.label: Pen
pen.description: A simple ballpoint pen. Civilization may be over, but someone still needs to write things down.

pencil.label: Pencil
pencil.description: A plain wooden pencil. It still works when the power is out, which gives it an advantage over most technology.

matchbox.label: Matchbox
matchbox.description: A small box of matches. Fire sold separately, one strike at a time.

lighter.label: Lighter
lighter.description: A pocket lighter with enough spark left to be useful. No one remembers who kept refilling it.

cigarette box.label: Cigarette Box
cigarette box.description: A sealed box of cigarettes. Bad for your health, assuming the zombies leave enough of it to worry about.

tea box.label: Tea Box
tea box.description: A box of dried tea bags. Civilization may have collapsed, but there is still time for a proper cup.

fabric.label: Fabric
fabric.description: A folded piece of sturdy fabric. Useful whenever something needs covering, tying, or patching.

coffee beans.label: Coffee Beans
coffee beans.description: A sealed bag of roasted coffee beans. Mornings ended with civilization, but the habit survived.

metal spare parts.label: Metal Spare Parts
metal spare parts.description: A mixed collection of salvaged metal components. None of them match, which usually means one will fit.

bag of salt.label: Bag of Salt
bag of salt.description: A sealed bag of ordinary salt. It makes food better and wounds significantly worse.

bag of sugar.label: Bag of Sugar
bag of sugar.description: A sealed bag of sugar. Sweet enough to improve morale and valuable enough to start arguments.

toilet paper.label: Toilet Paper
toilet paper.description: A clean roll of toilet paper. Once ordinary, now a soft and surprisingly valuable luxury.

plunger.label: Plunger
plunger.description: A sturdy rubber plunger. The world ended, but clogged pipes remain committed to the job.

soap.label: Soap
soap.description: A plain bar of soap. Clean hands still matter, even when everything else is filthy.

weapon parts.label: Weapon Parts
weapon parts.description: A collection of springs, pins, and machined components. Enough small pieces to make something considerably louder.

gunpowder.label: Gunpowder
gunpowder.description: A sealed container of gunpowder. Harmless until someone supplies pressure, a spark, and a terrible idea.

handgun casing.label: Handgun Casing
handgun casing.description: An empty brass handgun casing. The loud part is over; the useful part can begin again.

shell casing.label: Shell Casing
shell casing.description: A spent shotgun shell casing. Empty, battered, and ready to make another bad decision.

rifle casing.label: Rifle Casing
rifle casing.description: A spent rifle casing. Empty now, but still useful to anyone who knows how to reload it.

assault rifle casing.label: Assault Rifle Casing
assault rifle casing.description: A spent assault-rifle casing. Larger brass for larger problems.

gold chain.label: Gold Chain
gold chain.description: A polished gold chain from a time when looking expensive was the main concern.

silver necklace.label: Silver Necklace
silver necklace.description: A cool silver necklace with a stubborn shine. The apocalypse has done nothing for its resale value.

diamond ring.label: Diamond Ring
diamond ring.description: A diamond ring that still catches the light. Commitment lasted; civilization had other plans.

zombie bobblehead.label: Zombie Bobblehead
zombie bobblehead.description: A tiny zombie with an oversized wobbling head. Somehow less threatening at this scale.

ava bobblehead.label: Ava Bobblehead
ava bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Ava's likeness. The head nods along, whether she agrees or not.

peter bobblehead.label: Peter Bobblehead
peter bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Peter's likeness. Calm posture, permanently uncertain neck.

alynne bobblehead.label: Alynne Bobblehead
alynne bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Alynne's likeness. Small enough for a shelf, armed with a very serious expression.

luis bobblehead.label: Luis Bobblehead
luis bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Luis's likeness. It keeps its balance better than most survivors.

lara bobblehead.label: Lara Bobblehead
lara bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Lara's likeness. Even the tiny version looks ready for trouble.

jasper bobblehead.label: Jasper Bobblehead
jasper bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Jasper's likeness. The head keeps moving long after everyone else stops.

davis bobblehead.label: Davis Bobblehead
davis bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Davis's likeness. A rare survivor immortalized in cheap plastic.

rachel bobblehead.label: Rachel Bobblehead
rachel bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Rachel's likeness. The paint is chipped, but the resemblance survived.

bianca bobblehead.label: Bianca Bobblehead
bianca bobblehead.description: A bobblehead made in Bianca's likeness. Tiny, collectible, and impossible to take seriously during an argument.

dog statue.label: Dog Statue
dog statue.description: A small statue of a loyal dog. It still waits patiently for an owner who is not coming home.

tiger statue.label: Tiger Statue
tiger statue.description: A miniature tiger frozen mid-prowl. Fierce, decorative, and considerably safer than the real thing.

teddy bear.label: Teddy Bear
teddy bear.description: A worn teddy bear with one dependable smile. It has survived worse bedtime stories than most.

cloth doll.label: Cloth Doll
cloth doll.description: A handmade cloth doll with faded stitching. Someone cared enough to sew it twice.

toy car.label: Toy Car
toy car.description: A small toy car with scratched paint and stubborn wheels. Traffic is finally no longer a problem.

wristwatch.label: Wristwatch
wristwatch.description: A well-made wristwatch from when being late still mattered.

police badge.label: Police Badge
police badge.description: A tarnished police badge. Authority faded quickly; the metal held up better.

table clock.label: Table Clock
table clock.description: A small table clock that may never tell the right time again. It still looks punctual.

cookbook.label: Cookbook
cookbook.description: A stained cookbook full of meals requiring ingredients nobody has seen in months.

sci fi vhs.label: Sci-Fi VHS
sci fi vhs.description: A science-fiction movie on VHS. The future it imagined was somehow less strange.

gaming magazine.label: Gaming Magazine
gaming magazine.description: An old gaming magazine packed with previews, tips, and release dates that no longer matter.

fishing rod.label: Fishing Rod
fishing rod.description: A weathered fishing rod from quieter days. The fish may be the only things unaware the world ended.

crowbar.label: Crowbar
crowbar.description: A solid steel crowbar. Opens crates, doors, and arguments with equal enthusiasm.

axe.label: Axe
axe.description: A heavy two-handed axe. Originally made for wood; the edge is not particularly selective.

baseball bat.label: Baseball Bat
baseball bat.description: A sturdy wooden baseball bat. The season was cancelled, but batting practice continues.

hatchet.label: Hatchet
hatchet.description: A compact hatchet built for chopping branches. Undead limbs are close enough.

sledgehammer.label: Sledgehammer
sledgehammer.description: A massive sledgehammer for demolition, construction, and problems too stubborn for subtle tools.

Katana.label: Katana
Katana.description: A long, carefully forged blade. Elegant, deadly, and far too valuable to swing carelessly.

combat knife.label: Combat Knife
combat knife.description: A sturdy combat knife built for hard use. Compact, reliable, and never truly out of ammunition.

kitchen knife.label: Kitchen Knife
kitchen knife.description: An ordinary kitchen knife. Dinner preparation took a sharp turn.

glock 17.label: Glock 17
glock 17.description: A lightweight polymer-framed 9mm handgun. Simple, dependable, and found wherever reliability mattered.

beretta m9.label: Beretta M9
beretta m9.description: A full-size 9mm service pistol with a long military history. Heavy enough to feel reassuring.

m1911.label: M1911
m1911.description: A century-old .45 caliber design that refuses to retire. Heavy, simple, and still making its point.

taurus 38.label: Taurus 38
taurus 38.description: A compact revolver built for close calls. Five shots, no complicated explanations.

model 629.label: Model 629
model 629.description: A large-frame revolver chambered for .44 Magnum. Subtlety was never part of the design.

mossberg 500.label: Mossberg 500
mossberg 500.description: A sturdy pump-action shotgun built for rough handling. The action speaks louder than most warnings.

benelli m4.label: Benelli M4
benelli m4.description: A gas-operated tactical shotgun that cycles almost as quickly as trouble arrives.

uzi.label: Uzi
uzi.description: A compact 9mm submachine gun built for tight spaces and very loud disagreements.

h&k mp5.label: H&K MP5
h&k mp5.description: A compact 9mm submachine gun trusted by professionals. Smooth, controlled, and difficult to find.

kriss vector.label: Kriss Vector
kriss vector.description: An unconventional .45 caliber submachine gun designed to keep recoil under control. It looks like the future arrived early.

m4a1.label: M4A1
m4a1.description: A lightweight military carbine built around modular parts and 5.56x45 ammunition. Familiar for all the wrong reasons.

akm.label: AKM
akm.description: A rugged 7.62x39 rifle made to keep working through mud, neglect, and the end of civilization.

winchester model 70.label: Winchester Model 70
winchester model 70.description: A dependable bolt-action hunting rifle chambered in .308. One careful shot usually says enough.

springfield m1a.label: Springfield M1A
springfield m1a.description: A full-power 7.62x51 rifle with old military bones. Heavy, authoritative, and in no hurry to become obsolete.

9mm.label: 9mm
9mm.description: Common 9mm cartridges used by a wide range of handguns and compact firearms.

.45 acp.label: .45 ACP
.45 acp.description: Heavy .45 ACP cartridges for firearms that prefer a larger argument.

rt 85.label: RT 85
rt 85.description: Revolver cartridges packed for the Taurus 38. Simple ammunition for a simple solution.

.44 magnum.label: .44 Magnum
.44 magnum.description: Large .44 Magnum cartridges with enough recoil to make every shot a commitment.

20 gauge.label: 20 Gauge
20 gauge.description: Lightweight 20 Gauge shotgun shells. Still loud enough to wake the whole neighborhood.

12 gauge.label: 12 Gauge
12 gauge.description: Heavy 12 Gauge shotgun shells. Close-range diplomacy in a bright plastic casing.

5.56x45.label: 5.56x45
5.56x45.description: Lightweight 5.56x45 rifle cartridges. Small enough to carry plenty, rare enough to count every one.

7.62x39.label: 7.62x39
7.62x39.description: Rugged 7.62x39 rifle cartridges. Built for a weapon that considers dirt a minor inconvenience.

.308.description: Full-power .308 rifle cartridges meant for deliberate shots at uncomfortable distances.

7.62x51.label: 7.62x51
7.62x51.description: Full-power 7.62x51 rifle cartridges. Heavy ammunition for heavy-duty problems.

short range sight.label: Short-Range Sight
short range sight.description: A compact aiming sight built for fast target acquisition at short range.

medium range sight.label: Medium-Range Sight
medium range sight.description: A balanced aiming sight for targets that are neither close enough nor far enough to be convenient.

long range sight.label: Long-Range Sight
long range sight.description: A magnified aiming sight for making distant problems feel much closer.

handgun extended magazine.label: Handgun Extended Magazine
handgun extended magazine.description: An enlarged handgun magazine that holds more ammunition between reloads.

assault rifle extended magazine.label: Assault Rifle Extended Magazine
assault rifle extended magazine.description: An enlarged assault-rifle magazine that keeps the weapon firing longer between reloads.

handgun quick reload magazine.label: Handgun Quick-Reload Magazine
handgun quick reload magazine.description: A modified handgun magazine designed for faster reloads when every second is already late.

assault rifle quick reload magazine.label: Assault Rifle Quick-Reload Magazine
assault rifle quick reload magazine.description: A modified assault-rifle magazine built to get the weapon running again as quickly as possible.

drum magazine.label: Drum Magazine
drum magazine.description: A bulky drum magazine made for carrying an unreasonable amount of ammunition.

speed loader.label: Speed Loader
speed loader.description: A revolver speed loader that turns loose-round fumbling into one clean reload.

suppressor.label: Suppressor
suppressor.description: A muzzle-mounted suppressor that reduces the report of compatible firearms.

flash hider.label: Flash Hider
flash hider.description: A muzzle attachment designed to reduce the visible flash from firing.

muzzle brake.label: Muzzle Brake
muzzle brake.description: A vented muzzle attachment designed to tame recoil and annoy everyone standing nearby.

choke.label: Choke
choke.description: A shotgun muzzle attachment that reshapes the pellet spread for a more deliberate blast.

simple buttstock.label: Simple Buttstock
simple buttstock.description: A basic firearm stock offering a steadier shoulder position without unnecessary complexity.

advanced buttstock.label: Advanced Buttstock
advanced buttstock.description: An adjustable firearm stock built for improved handling and a more precise fit.

tactical flashlight.label: Tactical Flashlight
tactical flashlight.description: A weapon-mounted flashlight for identifying whatever is moving in the dark.

laser sight.label: Laser Sight
laser sight.description: A weapon-mounted laser that shows exactly where the bad decision is pointed.

laser flashlight combo.label: Laser-Flashlight Combo
laser flashlight combo.description: A combined laser and flashlight module for aiming at things you can now clearly see.

chrome cylinder.label: Chrome Cylinder
chrome cylinder.description: A polished revolver cylinder that looks almost too clean for the end of the world.

extended barrel.label: Extended Barrel
extended barrel.description: A longer revolver barrel built for shots that need a little more reach.

rubber grip.label: Rubber Grip
rubber grip.description: A textured rubber revolver grip for keeping control when things get messy.

shell carrier.label: Shell Carrier
shell carrier.description: A shotgun-mounted shell carrier that keeps the next reload close at hand.

vertical foregrip.label: Vertical Foregrip
vertical foregrip.description: A vertical foregrip that gives both hands something useful to do under pressure.

cheek rest.label: Cheek Rest
cheek rest.description: A padded rifle cheek rest for finding the same sight picture every time.

recoil pad.label: Recoil Pad
recoil pad.description: A rifle recoil pad that makes repeated shots slightly less punishing.

polished bolt.label: Polished Bolt
polished bolt.description: A carefully polished rifle bolt made to cycle smoothly when every second matters.

extended m1a magazine.label: Extended M1A Magazine
extended m1a magazine.description: An enlarged M1A magazine for solving more problems before the next reload.

quick reload m1a magazine.label: Quick-Reload M1A Magazine
quick reload m1a magazine.description: An M1A magazine prepared for faster changes when stopping to reload is a bad idea.

smg extended magazine.label: SMG Extended Magazine
smg extended magazine.description: An enlarged submachine-gun magazine for anyone who thinks thirty rounds go too quickly.

smg quick reload magazine.label: SMG Quick-Reload Magazine
smg quick reload magazine.description: A submachine-gun magazine designed to make reloads shorter and breathing room longer.

angled grip.label: Angled Grip
angled grip.description: An angled foregrip shaped for steadier control without getting in the way.

ergonomic foregrip.label: Ergonomic Foregrip
ergonomic foregrip.description: A contoured foregrip built to keep a weapon manageable through a long fight.

small backpack.label: Small Backpack
small backpack.description: A compact backpack for carrying a few more essentials. Every spare pocket matters now.

medium backpack.label: Medium Backpack
medium backpack.description: A practical backpack with room for a serious supply run. Try not to fill it with regrets.

large backpack.label: Large Backpack
large backpack.description: A large expedition backpack made for hauling everything you might need—and several things you definitely do not.

level 1 body armor.label: Level 1 Body Armor
level 1 body armor.description: Basic body armor offering the first layer between you and whatever is trying to bite through it.

level 2 body armor.label: Level 2 Body Armor
level 2 body armor.description: Reinforced body armor for survivors who have learned that one protective layer is rarely enough.

level 3 body armor.label: Level 3 Body Armor
level 3 body armor.description: Heavy body armor made for situations where avoiding danger is no longer an option.

level 4 body armor.label: Level 4 Body Armor
level 4 body armor.description: Top-grade body armor built for the worst encounters. Finding it may be the safest thing you do all week.

first aid spray recipe.label: First Aid Spray Recipe
first aid spray recipe.description: Instructions for making First Aid Spray. Better healing through careful reading.

medical herbs recipe.label: Medical Herbs Recipe
medical herbs recipe.description: Instructions for making Medical Herbs. Knowledge weighs less than supplies.

vitalis recipe.label: Vitalis Recipe
vitalis recipe.description: Instructions for making Vitalis. Knowledge weighs less than supplies.

bandage recipe.label: Bandage Recipe
bandage recipe.description: Instructions for making Bandage. Knowledge weighs less than supplies.

saline solution recipe.label: Saline Solution Recipe
saline solution recipe.description: Instructions for making Bottle of Saline Solution. Knowledge weighs less than supplies.

military bandage recipe.label: Military Bandage Recipe
military bandage recipe.description: Instructions for making Military Bandage. Knowledge weighs less than supplies.

first aid kit recipe.label: First Aid Kit Recipe
first aid kit recipe.description: Instructions for making First Aid Kit. Knowledge weighs less than supplies.

herbal poultice recipe.label: Herbal Poultice Recipe
herbal poultice recipe.description: Instructions for making Herbal Poultice. Knowledge weighs less than supplies.

tourniquet recipe.label: Tourniquet Recipe
